caption: The drawing features a single, dark brown, oval-shaped vessel with a narrow neck and small opening at the top. The surface of the vessel shows subtle variations in shading, suggesting a reflective, possibly glazed texture, with lighter brown and almost black areas to indicate the play of light and shadow. The vessel has a short, slightly flared base that appears to rest flat on an unseen surface. The background is plain, off-white, and the vessel is centered within a fine, reddish-brown rectangular border. The artist's name, "VINCENT F. ROSEL," and an additional notation are inscribed in small, red letters along the lower right edge of the border.
title: Stone Flask
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
